description: Postal code not in NNNN-NNN format
Geocoding reliability outside the domain (e.g. accent variant 'Fiável')
Coordinates text (LatLong) in a non-standard format
Same name, address, postal code and modality in more than one record
X/Y and LatLong more than 1 km apart
Located in a different municipality from the rest of its postal code
Capacity far above the norm for its modality (median + 10 MAD)
